name: Dark Iron Ambassador
summary: Deep within Gnomeregan, the Dark Iron Ambassador draws notice as an envoy of his clan. His presence leaves the clan’s interest in the ruined gnome capital unexplained.

sections.title: A Shadowy Envoy
sections.body: Among Gnomeregan’s irradiated halls, the Dark Iron Ambassador represents his clan. No one explains the purpose of his mission.

sections.title: Conspiracies in the Deep
sections.body: Investigators and goblins suspect the Dark Irons may be involved in Gnomeregan’s troubles and its mysterious super rig. Those suspicions remain theories. The ambassador’s presence does not prove who caused the city’s fall or what terms, if any, were agreed upon.

faq.q: Who is the Dark Iron Ambassador?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron Ambassador is an emissary of his clan found inside Gnomeregan. His precise diplomatic mission is unknown.

faq.q: Why is a Dark Iron dwarf inside Gnomeregan?
aliases: why are dark irons in gnomeregan
faq.answer: His purpose is unclear. His presence shows the Dark Iron clan has an interest in Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Did the Dark Irons help cause the fall of Gnomeregan?
aliases: did dark irons cause trogg invasion
faq.answer: That is unknown. Investigators have raised suspicions, but their theories do not prove who caused the disaster.

faq.q: Where does the ambassador come from?
faq.answer: He belongs to the Dark Iron clan, ruled by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

faq.q: Is he allied with Mekgineer Thermaplugg?
faq.answer: An alliance is suspected, but his presence alone confirms no agreement.

faq.q: Where can the Dark Iron Ambassador be found?
faq.answer: The Dark Iron Ambassador is an elusive, rare encounter who wanders the contaminated engineering sectors and workshop corridors inside Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may find the Dark Iron emissary in Gnomeregan troubling, and his presence raises questions for gnome investigators.
As a dwarf, you may see the presence of a Dark Iron dwarf in the ruined gnome city draw the attention of Ironforge allies.
As an Alliance member, you have reason to examine the Dark Iron presence in Gnomeregan.
